messages.subject: Hudbay | Corporate affairs, community value and responsible copper growth
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Brûlé,

Hudbay's current growth profile is compelling because it combines long-life operating assets with a major copper pipeline across Peru, Canada and the United States. That growth depends on strong community relations, disciplined external affairs and clear execution around regulatory and sustainability commitments.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I work directly across ministries, regulators, communities and internal business teams, converting external requirements into accountable action.

I would value a conversation about where this operating-side experience might support Hudbay's corporate-affairs, community, stakeholder or country-facing leadership needs as the company advances its next growth cycle. My attached CV has been prepared specifically around Hudbay's copper growth and community-focused operating model.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
